audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was framed as generic ranged poke; the actual mechanism — that every Orianna spell is anchored to the ball's position, not hers — was never stated.
audit.why: Command: Attack leaves the ball where it lands, Command: Dissonance detonates around the ball at 225, and Command: Shockwave launches enemies toward the ball. The ball is the threat marker, not Orianna.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10: you are not dodging Orianna, you are staying out of a 225-radius circle around a ball she moves every 3 to 7 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..5].side all read 'Skill' while the content layer read Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Kassadin.
audit.why: The content whys are right: Shockwave still punishes a level 6 blink, and the flip is the first item.
audit.corrected: phases[2], [3], [4] set to Orianna and phases[5] to Kassadin, matching win[2..5] which were already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important blink rule was absent: Command: Shockwave launches enemies toward the ball, so the safe Riftwalk destination is defined by ball position, not by Orianna's.
audit.why: Riot's text for Command: Shockwave states enemies are launched toward the Ball after a short delay. Riftwalking to a spot behind Orianna while the ball sits between you and her team walks you into the pull.
audit.corrected: Check where the ball is before you blink — Shockwave drags you to it, so blinking past Orianna onto her ball is blinking into her whole team.

audit.why: Command: Attack drops to a 3-second cooldown at max rank, Command: Dissonance is a flat 7, Command: Protect a flat 9, Command: Shockwave 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, with the 3-second Q noted as why her poke never stops.
